thread.title: AMD, Intel stocks rise after Cowen sees bullish read throughs from component suppliers

author: Emily Bary
title: AMD, Intel stocks rise after Cowen sees bullish read throughs from component suppliers
text: Cowen & Co. analyst Matthew Ramsey wrote Wednesday that his May readings from component suppliers in Taiwan delivered a "positive read through" for Advanced Micro Devices Inc. AMD, -2.45% and Intel Corp. INTC, -0.54% as well as a "somewhat positive" read through for Marvell Technology Group Ltd. MRVL, -2.07% and Silicon Motion Technology Corp. SIMO, +4.53% "May processor component suppliers reported revenue increased 6% M/M (8% Y/Y), or 200bps above seasonal," Ramsey wrote. He predicts that these results could be due to better-than-expected PC shipments and increased average selling prices. Ramsey wrote that his look at the Apple Inc. AAPL, -1.62% supply chain also showed above-seasonal numbers, as well as 16% year-over-year growth. AMD shares are up 32% over the past 12 months, while Intel's stock has gained 52% and the S&P 500 SPX, -0.40% has climbed 13%.
